details.customer_stories_reason: Our judgment: AI assistants cannot see logo images, so logos are not evidence an AI can quote. details.scoring_rule: Our own fixed formula, not an AI judgment and not an outside standard: each of the 4 evidence categories is worth up to 25 points by how many distinct pieces of evidence the code rules found ({0: 0, 1: 15, 2: 20}, 25 points for 3 or more). Finding none is a score of 0, not missing data.

details.voting_rule: Each field is judged on 3 independent runs. It is a conflict only if at least 2 runs say conflict, a match only if at least 2 runs say match, and unknown otherwise. The score counts voted conflicts: 0, 1, 2, 3 or more give 95, 60, 35, 10.

plain_finding.what_we_found: We compared what FreshBooks says on its own site about its free trial, product category, target customer, and deployment against what independent review sites say. All of it matches.
plain_finding.what_it_costs_you: Nothing here is costing you customers, so you can set this concern aside and focus your effort where real problems exist.
plain_finding.fix_it_today: Keep your site facts current by checking them against the top review sites once a quarter.

details.method_note: Check weights are our own judgment. AI crawler access, structured data, and heading structure come from GEO-16 (Kumar and Palkhouski, 2025). The static content check comes from Vercel and MERJ's December 2024 research, which found GPTBot and ClaudeBot only fetch raw HTML and never execute JavaScript, so content that only appears after a client-side render is invisible to them even though a human visitor sees it fine.

plain_finding.what_we_found: AI search tools can reach your homepage, but they read only the raw text and find no structured data that tells them what your company does, so they cannot describe your business clearly to customers.
plain_finding.what_it_costs_you: When a customer asks an AI search tool for a company like yours, it may name a competitor it can understand instead of you.
plain_finding.fix_it_today: Add simple structured data to your homepage that states your company name, what you sell, and your location, then test it with a free online checker.
